articles.title: Big Court and Ice T Launch OG Network as Streaming Platform Surpasses 2.3 Million Viewing Minutes
articles.mainIdea: Big Court and Ice T Launch OG Network as Streaming Platform Surpasses 2.3 Million Viewing Minutes
articles.summary: PR Newswire: Big Court and Ice T Launch OG Network as Streaming Platform Surpasses 2.3 Million Viewing Minutes. Media Executive Courtney "BigCourt" Richardson II, Founder of OG Network and host of Holdin' Court Podcast (Revolt TV), has partnered with Grammy Award–Winning Hip-Hop Icon & Actor Ice T(Co-Founder) to officially launch OG Network, a next-generation FAST and AVOD streaming platform spotlighting urban culture, independent storytellers, and premium original programming.
